F3.empty.reason: Questions are returned despite the complete report.

F3.only_missing.reason: Extra row visibility, selection and status metadata are unnecessary for this complete scenario.

F3.grounded.reason: No unsupported product feature or factual outcome is asserted.

F2.active_filter.reason: No question establishes the filter actually active at export.

F2.only_missing.reason: The repetition count is already supplied; a successful export appearance is unrelated to the reported attempt.

F2.distinct.reason: The requests concern separate details without repetition.

F2.grounded.reason: The question presupposes a successful export containing only permitted rows, which was not reported.

F6.coverage.reason: Required-field actions and results are requested, but actual name and fresh-form setup are not established.

F6.only_missing.reason: Required-field setup and actual results are absent from the observation.

F6.distinct.reason: The item appearance request substantially repeats the preceding actual-result question.

F6.grounded.reason: The question presupposes the intended name was actually used despite an empty observation.
